{{recipe}} 

'''''Gjellë me arra''''' is an Albanian dish of meat with walnuts. It is often made with veal or chicken. 

==Ingredients==
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
*15 shelled [[Cookbook:Walnut|walnuts]], finely crushed 
*2 [[Cookbook:Egg Yolk|egg yolks]], [[Cookbook:Beaten Egg|beaten]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]] clove, [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]]
*¼ [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] (1 stick / 8 tbsp) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
*2–3 lbs of [[Cookbook:Veal|veal]] or [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] meat, cut into 1-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] cubes 

==Procedure==
# Place the meat or chicken in a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]], and cook over medium heat until tender. 
#Remove the meat, and set it aside in a dish while leaving the remaining juices in the saucepan. 
#In another saucepan, add the flour and stir over heat until it becomes light brown in color—do not overcook! Then, add half the butter.
#Add the walnuts, garlic, and egg yolks, stirring constantly. 
#Add the meat juices from the other saucepan, and stir until all the ingredients thicken. Immediately remove from the heat to avoid solidifying the egg yolks. [[Cookbook:Folding|Fold]] in the meat. 
#Pan fry the remaining half stick of butter until brown, and pour over the dish before serving.
